steps: Pad the side-elevation profile 30 mm symmetrically about its plane, using a collar centred 65.5 mm from the left end with a 48 mm outside diameter and 42 mm bore, a 15 mm-high left arm extending to the left end, and a 30 mm-high right ear extending to an assumed right end 34.5 mm from the collar axis for an assumed controlling overall length of 100 mm.
Trim the longitudinal ends in the collar-axis view to a 15 mm-radius left semicircle and a 14.5 mm-radius right semicircle across the 30 mm width.

Pocket an assumed 18 mm-wide central fork cavity through the left arm, leaving two 6 mm side rails and extending longitudinally from the plane through the left-hole axis to the outside wall of the collar.
Pocket a 2 mm-wide slit through the full 30 mm collar width and from the 42 mm bore through the right end, centred on the collar axis to divide the 30 mm-high right ear into two 14 mm-high tabs.
Cut a 6.6 mm through hole normal to the left arm's broad faces, centred across the 30 mm width and 15.5 mm from the left end, with an 11 mm-diameter counterbore 6 mm deep from the upper outer face.
Cut a 6.6 mm through hole normal to the right ear's broad faces, centred across the 30 mm width and 14.5 mm from the assumed right end.
Pocket an assumed regular hexagonal nut recess 11 mm across opposite flat faces and 6 mm deep into the upper outer face around the right through hole.
Fillet the external longitudinal edges identified in red on the drawing to a 2 mm radius.
Assign the part an assumed AISI 1020 plain carbon steel material card.

In Body, sketch on the XY plane (the plane of the length and the height) a circle of radius 25 mm (Ø50) centred at the origin, and pad it 30 mm symmetric about that plane. The origin is the ring axis; the depth runs along Z, front to rear, so the pad's 30 mm is the full depth of the part and the depth centre plane is Z=0. This fixes the left end tangent plane at x = -65.5 mm and the right end tangent plane at x = +42.5 mm, the bottom face at y = -25 mm (25 mm below the ring axis, the ring's lowest tangent plane) and the ring's top tangent plane at y = +25 mm, so the height is 25 + 25 = 50 mm. The ring axis is the sheet's x = 90.73 line work. Build Phase 1 (page 1) only — no page 2 angled arm and no c'bore slot.

Pad the arm: sketch in the plane of the length and the depth on the bottom face level, y = -25 mm (XZ orientation, offset 25 mm below the ring axis), a closed profile made of a semicircular left end of radius 15 mm centred at x = -50.5 mm, z = 0 — its left extreme is at -50.5 - 15 = -65.5 mm, exactly the left end tangent plane, which with the right end tangent plane at +42.5 gives the envelope length 65.5 + 42.5 = 108 mm — with straight sides at z = +15 mm and z = -15 mm (full 30 mm depth, symmetric about the depth centre plane) running right to a closing line at x = 0, inside the ring. Pad it 15 mm upward, from y = -25 mm to y = -10 mm, fusing it to the ring; the arm's underside is the bottom face.

Pad the right ear: sketch in the plane of the length and the depth at y = -15 mm (15 mm below the ring axis), a closed profile made of a semicircular right end of radius 12.5 mm centred at x = +30 mm, z = 0 — its right extreme is at 30 + 12.5 = 42.5 mm, the right end tangent plane — with straight sides at z = +12.5 mm and z = -12.5 mm (25 mm deep, symmetric about the depth centre plane, 2.5 mm in from each of the front and rear faces at z = ±15) running left to a closing line at x = 0, inside the ring. Pad it 30 mm upward, from y = -15 mm to y = +15 mm, fusing it to the ring, so the ear's top face stands 15 mm above the ring axis. The full-depth ring becomes the 25 mm deep ear where the Ø50 outside meets the ear top level: sqrt(25² - 15²) = 20 mm, about 21 mm right of the ring axis — the sheet's x = 111.9 line work, with y = 55.89 and y = 61.6 the ear's blend line work at 7.89 mm and 13.6 mm above the ring axis.

Cut the Ø42 pipe bore: sketch a circle of radius 21 mm centred on the ring axis (x = 0, y = 0) in the plane of the length and the height, and pocket it through all in both directions along the depth, so it runs front face to rear face. Its axis is the ring axis, 65.5 mm from the left end tangent plane and 25 mm above the bottom face.

Cut the 2 mm clamping split: sketch in the plane of the length and the height a rectangle from x = 0 (inside the Ø42 bore) to x = 50 mm (past the right end tangent plane at 42.5 mm, so it breaks out at the right end face), spanning y = -1 mm to y = +1 mm — 2 mm wide, symmetric about the ring axis, walls perpendicular to the height — and pocket it through all in both directions along the depth, cutting the full 25 mm depth of the ear and splitting the ring on that side.

Cut the left arm hole: a Ø6.6 hole with a Ø11 counterbore 6 mm deep, positioned at x = -50.5 mm (50.5 mm left of the ring axis, 15 mm right of the left end tangent plane at -65.5) and z = 0 on the depth centre plane, its axis along the height perpendicular to the bottom face. It is sketched on the bottom face at y = -25 mm and runs up through the arm's full 15 mm height, the counterbore taken 6 mm deep from the bottom face.

Cut the ear hole: a Ø6.6 hole with a Ø11 counterbore 6 mm deep, positioned at x = +30 mm (30 mm right of the ring axis, 12.5 mm left of the right end tangent plane at +42.5, on the centre of the R12.5 end) and z = 0 on the depth centre plane, its axis along the height perpendicular to the ear's top and bottom faces so it crosses the 2 mm split at right angles. It is sketched on the ear's bottom face at y = -15 mm and runs up through the full 30 mm height of the ear, the counterbore taken 6 mm deep from that bottom face. This axis is the sheet's x = 120.69 line work, with x = 120.45 the counterbore line work beside it.

Cut the hexagonal recess in the upper lug: sketch a regular hexagon centred at x = +30 mm, z = 0 on the ear's top face at y = +15 mm, assumed across flats 11 mm, so its circumradius is 11 / (2 * cos(30°)) = 5.5 / 0.86603 = 6.351 mm, with one pair of flats parallel to the length. Pocket it 6 mm downward from the top face, to y = +9 mm.

Cut the through slot at the left end of the arm cutout: sketch in the plane of the length and the depth a rectangle spanning z = -7 mm to z = +7 mm (14 mm across the depth, symmetric about the depth centre plane) and running along the length from x = -30 mm (the left wall of the cutout, 30 mm left of the ring axis) to an assumed x = -18 mm, an assumed slot length of 12 mm since VIEW B carries no dimension for it. Pocket it through the whole 15 mm of the arm, from the arm's top face at y = -10 mm down through the bottom face at y = -25 mm, its axis along the height perpendicular to the bottom face — the slot is bounded by both faces and starts at neither, so nothing places it in the height.

Cut the shallow recess of the arm cutout, open at the arm's top face: sketch on the arm's top face at y = -10 mm a profile 16 mm wide across the depth, from z = -8 mm to z = +8 mm — its near wall 7 mm in from the front face at z = +15 mm (15 - 7 = 8), symmetric about the depth centre plane — running along the length from the left wall at x = -30 mm and closed on the right by an arc of radius 25 mm centred on the ring axis, so the recess follows the ring's outside and leaves the curved rib drawn in VIEW B. Pocket it an assumed 5 mm deep below the arm's top face, to a floor at y = -15 mm, since VIEW B carries no depth dimension.

Apply an R2 fillet, typical, to the red-marked edges: select the arm's top face and the ear's top face — 2 faces — and round every edge of those two face outlines at radius 2 mm, each fillet lying in the plane normal to the edge it rounds.
Assign the plain carbon steel material card to the Body, taking its uuid from the materials tool and setting ShapeMaterial to the Materials.Material that uuid returns.

In the Body, sketch the obround outer profile on the XZ plane (the plane of the length and the height, all dimensions in millimetres) and pad it 100 mm in the depth direction, from the front face to the rear face. Profile: an R25 arc centred at (-50, 0) and an R25 arc centred at (+50, 0), joined by the tangent lines y = +25 and y = -25 running between x = -50 and x = +50; the sketch origin is the intersection of the central transverse plane with the mid-height centre line. This puts the extremes at x = -50 - 25 = -75 mm and x = +50 + 25 = +75 mm, giving the 150 mm overall length, and the profile 25 + 25 = 50 mm tall, giving the 50 mm height. Note on the recorded conflict: the entry 'the left end radius centre 75 mm to the left, the right end radius centre 75 mm to the right' is taken as the half-overall to the end TANGENT planes, not to the arc centres — centres at 75 with R25 would give 200 mm and contradict the printed 150; the arc centres are built on the Ø40 bore axes at 50 mm each side, as the front view and SECTION B-B show, and the tangent planes then land at 75 mm each side.

Cut the left Ø40 bore through the solid, its axis running front to rear perpendicular to the front face, positioned 50 mm to the left of the central transverse plane and at mid-height, 25 mm below the top face — i.e. a Ø40 circle centred at (-50, 0) in the same length-and-height plane as the outer profile, cut through all in the depth direction so it opens on both the front and the rear face.

Cut the right Ø40 bore through the solid, its axis running front to rear perpendicular to the front face, positioned 50 mm to the right of the central transverse plane and at mid-height, 25 mm below the top face — a Ø40 circle centred at (+50, 0) in the length-and-height plane, cut through all in the depth direction so it opens on both the front and the rear face.

Cut the Ø35 through hole from the top face down to the bottom face, its axis vertical (perpendicular to the top face and so perpendicular to both Ø40 bore axes), lying in the central transverse plane at 0 mm along the length, and 50 mm from the front face — mid-depth of the 100 mm. Cut through all so it is open over the full 50 mm height.

Cut the front pocket into the central web, opening at the front face and running 20 mm into the part. Draw its profile in the plane of the length and the height, positioned at the front face, and cut in the depth direction toward the rear (reverse the cut direction if the sketch normal points out of the material). Profile: top wall at y = +15 (10 mm down from the top face at y = +25), bottom wall at y = -15 (10 mm up from the bottom face at y = -25), so the pocket is 30 mm tall; the left end wall is a concave R30 arc centred on the left bore axis at (-50, 0) — R30 = the Ø40 bore's R20 plus 10 mm of web — running between (-50 + sqrt(30² - 15²), +15) = (-24.02, +15) and (-24.02, -15) through (-20, 0); the right end wall is the mirror R30 arc centred on the right bore axis at (+50, 0), running between (+24.02, -15) and (+24.02, +15) through (+20, 0).

Cut the rear pocket into the central web, opening at the rear face and running 20 mm into the part — the mirror of the front pocket. Draw the same profile in the plane of the length and the height, positioned at the rear face, and cut in the depth direction toward the front (reverse the cut direction if the sketch normal points out of the material). Profile: top wall at y = +15, bottom wall at y = -15 (30 mm tall, 10 mm from the top face and 10 mm from the bottom face); left end wall a concave R30 arc centred on the left bore axis at (-50, 0) from (-24.02, +15) to (-24.02, -15) through (-20, 0); right end wall the R30 arc centred on the right bore axis at (+50, 0) from (+24.02, -15) to (+24.02, +15) through (+20, 0).

Fillet R2 the red edges lying on the front face: the whole obround outer perimeter loop there (its two R25 end arcs and its two straight top and bottom edges, 4 edges), the two Ø40 bore mouth circles (2 edges), and the mouth loop of the front pocket (its two R30 end arcs and its two straight edges, 4 edges) — 10 edges in all, selected on the front face.

Fillet R2 the red edges lying on the rear face: the whole obround outer perimeter loop there (two R25 end arcs and two straight edges, 4 edges), the two Ø40 bore mouth circles (2 edges), and the mouth loop of the rear pocket (two R30 end arcs and two straight edges, 4 edges) — 10 edges in all, selected on the rear face.

Assign the plain carbon steel material card to the Body, setting ShapeMaterial from the material manager's card for plain carbon steel (look the card's uuid up in this build's material library rather than assuming one).

Створити Body і в ескізі на площині XY побудувати замкнений боковий профіль основної тяги: нижній центр (0,0), зовнішнє нижнє вушко Ø80, верхній центр (40,100), зовнішнє верхнє вушко R25, з’єднати їх обчисленими дотичними дугами зовнішнього контуру R200 та двома внутрішніми переходами R50; витягнути цей профіль симетрично до загальної товщини 40.

На площині XY вирізати наскрізь через товщину 40 нижній отвір Ø50 разом із верхнім шпонковим пазом: прийняти показаний розмір 14 як ширину паза та, оскільки глибину не задано, прийняти радіальну глибину паза 7 від верхньої кромки отвору.

На двох зовнішніх бокових гранях у зоні верхнього вушка додати матеріал за його зовнішнім контуром R25 та прилеглою шийкою, по 5 мм назовні з кожного боку; це збільшує товщину верхньої частини з 40 до заданих 50.

На центральній площині товщини створити ескіз вилкового прорізу та виконати симетричну кишеню шириною 20, залишаючи два верхні вушка товщиною по 15; оскільки креслення не задає довжину прорізу, прийняти його закінчення на 30 мм нижче центра верхнього отвору, з напівкруглим кінцем R10.
Вирізати наскрізний отвір Ø30 по осі верхнього вушка з центром у точці (40,100), через всю товщину вилки 50.
Застосувати скруглення R4 до всіх ребер, позначених червоним на кресленні: зовнішніх крайок основного профілю, крайок нижнього отвору й паза, крайок верхнього отвору та крайок вилкового прорізу.

On the XY plane (the plate underside, z=0), sketch the plate outline: a rectangle from X=0 to X=80 and Y=0 to Y=30, with all four corners rounded R8 (arc centres at (8,8), (72,8), (72,22), (8,22)), and pad it 5 mm in +Z.
Sketch a Ø20 circle centred at X=60, Y=15 on the plate top face (z=5) and pad it 15 mm in +Z, so the boss top lies at 5+15=20 mm above the plate underside.

Sketch a Ø20 circle in the plane of the length and the height (XZ, at the mid-depth centre plane Y=15), centred at X=20, Z=-10 (10 mm below the plate underside), and pad it 20 mm symmetric to that plane — assumed lug thickness front to rear 20 mm, since the drawing does not define it. Its lowest point is at -10-10 = -20 mm, and with the boss top at +20 mm the overall height is 40 mm.
Sketch a Ø15 circle centred at X=60, Y=15 on the boss top face and pocket it through all, downward through the boss and the plate.
Sketch a Ø10 circle in the plane of the length and the height at the lug's front face, centred at X=20, Z=-10, and pocket it through all along the depth direction, through the lug.

Sketch the rib web in the plane of the length and the height at the mid-depth centre plane (Y=15): a closed triangle with vertices (X=5, Z=5) on the plate top face, (X=52, Z=5) and (X=52, Z=20), the X=52 edge buried inside the Ø20 boss which spans X=50 to X=70. Pad it 4 mm symmetric about that plane, i.e. 2 mm each side of Y=15.

Apply an R2 fillet to the blend edges of the solid: the rib-to-plate edges, the rib-to-boss edges, the rib's sloping top edge, the boss-to-plate circular edge, the lug-to-plate blend edges, and the plate's own top and bottom outline edges — selected by computing which edges lie at those junctions, not with UseAllEdges.
Assign the plain carbon steel material card to the Body by setting ShapeMaterial from Materials.MaterialManager(), looking up the card's uuid from the manager's library rather than assuming one.

Create a single closed length-height base profile on the plane of the length and height, then pad it 30 mm from the front face to the rear face. Form the profile as the union of a Ø50 outer ring centered 65.5 mm from the leftmost tangent plane and 25 mm above the lower tangent plane, a 15 mm-high left arm with its lower face on the lower tangent plane and a semicircular left end tangent at the leftmost plane, and a right lug with a 12.5 mm outer-end radius, lower face 10 mm above the lower tangent plane, and rightmost tangent plane 42.5 mm right of the ring axis. Set the overall profile envelope to 108 mm long and 50 mm high.
Pocket a concentric Ø42 bore through all 30 mm of the outer ring, normal to the front face.

Machine the left mounting hole on the longitudinal centre plane: drill Ø6.6 through all 30 mm and counterbore Ø11 to 6 mm deep from the front face, with the hole axis 14 mm from the leftmost tangent plane and 7 mm above the lower tangent plane.

Machine the right mounting hole on the longitudinal centre plane: drill Ø6.6 through all 30 mm, counterbore Ø11 to 6 mm deep from the front face, and cut a regular hexagonal 11 mm across-flats recess 6 mm deep from the rear face; locate its axis 30 mm right of the ring axis.

Pocket the central cutout from the front face through the central 18 mm front-to-rear region, leaving 6 mm side portions at both the front and rear faces. Use an assumed open-ended rectangular cutout in the length-height plane with its left end face 30 mm left of the ring axis, extending right to the rightmost tangent plane, from the lower tangent plane to the assumed horizontal boundary 10 mm above it.

Pocket an assumed 3 mm-high longitudinal ring split through all 30 mm between the front and rear faces, from the assumed right-hand intersection of the Ø42 bore surface to the rightmost tangent plane of the lug; place its lower boundary 2 mm below the ring axis and its assumed upper boundary 1 mm above the ring axis.

Apply 2 mm radius fillets to the assumed external 30 mm-long profile edges of the base solid and its mounting-lug outline, excluding bore, mounting-hole, counterbore, hexagonal-recess, central-cutout, and ring-split edges.
Assign the plain carbon steel material card to the completed body.
Створити в наявному Body об’єкт ескізу типу Sketcher::SketchObject з назвою RootProfile через Body.addObject.
Приєднати ескіз RootProfile до XY-площини Origin через AttachmentSupport і MapMode = FlatFace.

У ескізі RootProfile створити геометрію типу Part.Circle з центром (0, 0) мм і радіусом 17.5 мм; це кореневе коло для прийнятих модуля 2 мм, 20 зубців, діаметра ділильного кола 40 мм і діаметра западин 35 мм.
Створити feature типу PartDesign::Pad у Body з ескізу RootProfile, довжиною 10 мм у додатному напрямку нормалі XY-площини, без симетричного витягування.
Створити в наявному Body об’єкт ескізу типу Sketcher::SketchObject з назвою ToothProfile через Body.addObject.
Приєднати ескіз ToothProfile до XY-площини Origin через AttachmentSupport і MapMode = FlatFace.

У ескізі ToothProfile створити геометрію типу Part.LineSegment для нижньої радіальної частини зубця від (17.464, -1.115) мм до (18.756, -1.197) мм. Значення відповідають кореневому радіусу 17.5 мм, базовому радіусу 18.794 мм, куту тиску 20° та куту розташування флангу 3.652°.

У ескізі ToothProfile створити геометрію типу Part.BSplineCurve для нижнього евольвентного флангу через обчислені точки (18.756, -1.197), (18.970, -1.232), (19.594, -1.427), (20.570, -1.895) і (21.826, -2.757) мм. Точки обчислити для базового радіуса 18.794 мм, параметрів евольвенти t = 0, 0.1521, 0.3043, 0.4564, 0.6085 та зовнішнього радіуса 22 мм.

У ескізі ToothProfile створити геометрію типу Part.ArcOfCircle: дугу з центром (0, 0) мм, радіусом 22 мм, між точками (21.826, -2.757) мм і (21.826, 2.757) мм, з кутовим розмахом 14.400° через напрямок додатної осі X; це вершина одного зубця.

У ескізі ToothProfile створити геометрію типу Part.BSplineCurve для верхнього евольвентного флангу через обчислені точки (21.826, 2.757), (20.570, 1.895), (19.594, 1.427), (18.970, 1.232) і (18.756, 1.197) мм; це дзеркальне відображення нижнього евольвентного флангу відносно осі X.
У ескізі ToothProfile створити геометрію типу Part.LineSegment для верхньої радіальної частини зубця від (18.756, 1.197) мм до (17.464, 1.115) мм.

У ескізі ToothProfile створити геометрію типу Part.ArcOfCircle: коротку дугу з центром (0, 0) мм, радіусом 17.5 мм, між точками (17.464, 1.115) мм і (17.464, -1.115) мм, з кутовим розмахом 7.304° через напрямок додатної осі X, щоб замкнути профіль зубця.

Створити feature типу PartDesign::Pad у Body з ескізу ToothProfile, довжиною 10 мм у додатному напрямку нормалі XY-площини, без симетричного витягування; витягування має об’єднатися з уже наявним кореневим диском.
Створити feature типу PartDesign::PolarPattern у Body для щойно створеного зубчастого Pad: вісь обертання Z-axis Body, кількість входжень 20, кут 360°, рівномірний кутовий крок 18°.
Створити в наявному Body об’єкт ескізу типу Sketcher::SketchObject з назвою BoreProfile через Body.addObject.
Приєднати ескіз BoreProfile до XY-площини Origin через AttachmentSupport і MapMode = FlatFace.
У ескізі BoreProfile створити геометрію типу Part.Circle з центром (0, 0) мм і радіусом 4 мм; це прийнятий центральний наскрізний отвір діаметром 8 мм.
Створити feature типу PartDesign::Pocket у Body з ескізу BoreProfile, довжиною 10 мм у додатному напрямку нормалі XY-площини, без симетричного вирізання.

Sketch the composite outer profile in the XZ-plane (length × height): a Ø50 circle centred at (65.5, 25.01); a flat arm 15 mm thick from the tangent plane at x=0 (left end rounded R7.5, centred at (7.5, 7.5)) to the ring, its bottom face at z=0 tangent to the ring's underside; and a lug block 30 mm tall (z from 10.01 to 40.01, i.e. 15 mm each side of the ring axis) running from the ring to the right end face at x=108 — one closed contour merging all three. Pad it 30 mm deep, symmetric about the XZ-plane (±15 mm front to rear).
Cut the ring bore: a Ø42 pocket on the ring axis at (65.5, 25.01), through all along the front-to-rear direction (Type ThroughAll, axis perpendicular to the front face).

Narrow the arm to its 14 mm depth width: pocket both sides of the arm (left of the ring) in the depth direction, leaving the arm 7 mm each side of the centre plane of the depth, through the full 15 mm arm height.

Cut the horizontal split through the lug block: a slot through the full 30 mm depth of the lug, 3 mm wide in height, its upper face 1 mm above the ring axis (z = 26.01) and its lower face 2 mm below (z = 23.01), running from the ring bore to the right end face along the length.

Drill the tab hole: a Ø6.6 vertical hole through the 15 mm arm thickness, centred at (7.5, 0) — coincident with the centre of the R7.5 rounded tab end and centred on the 14 mm tab width — with a Ø11 counterbore 6 mm deep from the bottom face of the arm (c'bore for M6 SHCS).

Drill the boss hole: a Ø6.6 vertical hole through the 30 mm tall lug, centred on the centre plane of the depth at the centre of the R12.5 rounded right end (x = 95.5, y = 0), with a Ø11 round counterbore 6 mm deep from the bottom face and a hexagonal socket HEX Ø11, 6 mm deep, from the top face (c'bore and hex for M6 SHCS).

Cut the tapered through cutout in the arm: a slot through the 15 mm arm thickness, 30 mm long from the ring-centre plane region toward the left (x from 35.5 to 65.5), symmetric about the centre plane of the depth, with a narrow round end at its left and flaring wider toward the ring — the width and flare are not dimensioned on the sheet, so assume a Ø6 round left end flaring to 12 mm wide at the ring end.
Fillet R2 on the exterior perimeter edges and the cutout edges (the edges drawn red in every view).

Pad a 30 mm-deep base profile symmetrically about the ring mid-plane in the plane of length and height: form the Ø50 outer circular ring and the right-hand fork, with the ring and bore circles concentric on the ring axis; set the right fork 30 mm high, symmetric about the ring mid-plane, with R12.5 rounded outer lug ends whose outer end faces are 42.5 mm from the ring axis; include the centred 2 mm fork split, with each split face 1 mm from the ring axis, creating derived 14 mm upper and lower prongs. Form the lower-left open curved boundary as the Ø50 ring surface tangent to the adjoining arm contour rather than as a separately dimensioned cutout.

Add the Phase 2 angled left arm as a 14 mm-wide additive profile centred on the ring mid-plane, with its centre plane 7 mm from either angled-arm side face; make its lower straight edge tangent to the R25 outer-ring profile, make the arm 15 mm wide perpendicular to that lower tangent line, set its free planar end face 73 mm from the ring axis along a 45.0° centreline, and use an assumed R2 concave transition between the upper arm edge and the outer ring.
Pocket the concentric Ø42 ring bore through all 30 mm of the base profile, perpendicular to the plane of length and height, retaining the right-hand open split shown in the fork.
Pocket the right mounting bore Ø6.6 through all from the front face at the rounded right lug axis, then counterbore it Ø11 to a depth of 6 mm from the front face.
Pocket a regular hexagonal recess, 11 mm across its specified enclosing diameter and 6 mm deep from the front face, concentric with the right mounting-hole axis around the right counterbore.

Pocket the Phase 2 left mounting through-slot from the front face through all of the 14 mm-wide angled arm: use Ø6.6 rounded ends on 8 mm end-axis spacing for a derived 14.6 mm overall slot length, centred through the arm width; locate its centre midway between the end axes at an assumed 19 mm from the angled-arm free-end face along the 45.0° arm centreline. Counterbore the same slot from the front face with Ø11 rounded ends on the same 8 mm end-axis spacing, 19 mm overall length, to a depth of 6 mm.
